ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~19 day(s) ago @ 681.54) and overbought (daily RSI 67, 3-day 74 & weekly 81). entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended and overbought (daily RSI 67, 3-day 74 & weekly 81). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
